name: Technician Performance
_notes: screens holds paths only. The host comes from KPI_BASE_URL at run time, because this
file is committed and the tenant hostname is a customer's.
No matching rules: this module aligns entirely on automatic matching. Rows are
technicians, matched by name similarity — one screen renders a technician as
'#1 HERIBERTO XAVIER AVILA (4158) I' and the other as 'HERIBERTO AVILA 4158', which the
normalizer and token-set similarity handle without aliases.
Last verified: 624/624 value cells matched, no differences. If a future run reports
far fewer than 624 cells, the column geometry stopped resolving — check the grid's
header rows rather than adding tolerances.
